mapper.select: SELECT hc.id AS comparison_id, ha.id AS house_a_id, ha.location AS house_a_location, ha.deposit AS house_a_deposit, ha.monthly_rent AS house_a_monthly_rent, ha.maintenance_fee AS house_a_maintenance_fee, ha.area AS house_a_area, ha.station_walk_minutes AS house_a_station_walk_minutes, ha.commute_minutes AS house_a_commute_minutes, ha.floor_type AS house_a_floor_type, ha.room_structure AS house_a_room_structure, ha.option_type AS house_a_option_type, hb.id AS house_b_id, hb.location AS house_b_location, hb.deposit AS house_b_deposit, hb.monthly_rent AS house_b_monthly_rent, hb.maintenance_fee AS house_b_maintenance_fee, hb.area AS house_b_area, hb.station_walk_minutes AS house_b_station_walk_minutes, hb.commute_minutes AS house_b_commute_minutes, hb.floor_type AS house_b_floor_type, hb.room_structure AS house_b_room_structure, hb.option_type AS house_b_option_type, CASE WHEN ha.id IS NOT NULL AND hb.id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS balance_game_available FROM house_comparisons hc LEFT JOIN houses ha ON ha.comparison_id = hc.id AND ha.house_type = 'A' LEFT JOIN houses hb ON hb.comparison_id = hc.id AND hb.house_type = 'B' WHERE hc.user_id = #{userId}
